English: Sacred Clearing
A simple, open clearing in the woods, marked by stones and firepits, where the folk gather for council and defense.
Stones Circle
Stones raised in a circle mark the gathering place, offering a stronger sense of unity and simple defense.
Wooden Gathering Hall
A timber hall is erected at the heart of the circle, sheltering leaders and warriors during times of need.
Totem Yard
Tall wooden totems ring the hall, intimidating foes and rallying clansfolk to arms.
Feast Hall
A great hall for feasting and ceremony strengthens bonds and discipline among the folk.
Ringfort Hall
A timber-and-earth ringfort rises around the hall, offering serious fortification and protection for all within.
Chieftains Lodge
A sturdy, lavish lodge for the chieftain and their advisors, inspiring loyalty and martial spirit among the people.
Council Hall
A grand hall with space for all elders and warriors to gather, organize, and make decisions for the clans future.
Ancestor Hall
An imposing stone and timber hall, adorned with clan totems and ancestral relics, instilling awe and discipline.
Great Moot Hall
The ultimate seat of pagan assembly: stone-walled, bannered, and awe-inspiring, it is the very heart of the realms defense and unity.
